Theorem
[Three-dimensional Type II ancient solutions have asymptotic shrinkers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0186, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0187 1. ch30:30.36\group Type I Ancient Solutions

Every three-dimensional $\kappa $-noncollapsed Type II ancient Ricci flow with bounded curvature has a backward asymptotic shrinker.
